text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing that Twin Turbo wasn't feeling well, I decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Daryaa... Ugh, Turbo can still run...!
choice_data_list: You can just rest a bit and then run again.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Okay, fine.
Turbo's going to sleep then.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll be running again as soon as I wake up, though!
Good night, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What is this place!?
It's huge... super duper huge!?
No walls! There's nothing at all!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh... Turbo's gonna run!!
Turbo engine, ignite!!
Daaaryaaaaaahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah... Huh?!
Amazing!! I'm not tired at all!!
I can keep running!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo has no rivals left!!
At this rate, I'll be way out in front the whole time,
zooming and whizzing—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nngh-gah!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh!? The infirmary!? What happened to that huge open space from earlier!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... A dream?
Was Turbo dreaming?
Hmmm??

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Well, oh well!! Turbo is super energetic!!
I got to run a whole bunch in my dream,
so I feel great!! That was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo seems to have regained
her energy after getting plenty of rest.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah...!
Trainer, did you see that!?
Was Turbo amazing just no—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah!! This is boring!!
Even if running is fun, I hate this!
Where Turbo really runs is—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Just watch me!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A dream!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Even though I ran a ton,
I couldn't show everyone
how awesome Turbo is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Mmmh... Turbo's bored!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even though she had been lying down,
Twin Turbo's condition
didn't seem to improve.
